description.value: Hariyali Express is an authentic Indian restaurant on Vancouver's cycling-friendly Commercial Drive, helmed by Chef Anil Rawat whose 20-plus years of experience span kitchens in India, Germany, and Canada. The menu covers tandoori classics, aromatic curries, street-food favorites, and Indian sweets, with dietary labels clearly indicating gluten-free, dairy-free, vegetarian, and vegan choices. Dine-in, takeout, delivery, and catering are all available, making it a versatile stop for riders exploring the Drive.

bike_parking_detail: 9 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 12m; stands (2 spaces) at 29m; stands (2 spaces) at 31m; stands (2 spaces) at 39m; rack (5 spaces) at 53m; stands (2 spaces) at 53m; stands (2 spaces) at 56m; stands (2 spaces) at 88m; stands (2 spaces) at 96m. Total: 21 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at hariyaliexpress.com directly corroborates the OSM address (2066 Commercial Drive, Vancouver V5N 4A9) and phone (604-215-7556). Takeout is confirmed by the website's navigation ('Takeout & Delivery') and About page ('Premium Indian Takeout'). Vegetarian, vegan, and GF options are confirmed by the menu listing a 'VEGAN THALI', 'Vegetarian & Non-Vegetarian Options' on the About page, and GF/DF dietary labels on multiple appetizers. No evidence was found on the website for bike parking, water refill, or washrooms.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Hariyali Express is an operational, full-service Indian restaurant on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, a well-known cycling corridor, with confirmed takeout and strong vegetarian/vegan/GF menu options relevant to touring cyclists. Required criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) are unconfirmed from the website but this is a data-gap rather than a disqualifier.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'VEGAN THALI'; About page lists 'Vegetarian & Non-Vegetarian Options'; multiple appetizers carry GF (gluten-free) and DF (dairy-free) labels

wow_evidence: authentic Indian restaurant on Vancouver's cycling-friendly Commercial Drive
